name: treasury-swap-guard
description: DAO and team treasury swaps on SaucerSwap V2 (Hedera testnet) with an on-chain policy guard, roles, pause and HCS receipts

steps.label: UI mode (no deploy)
steps.text: Fund a Hedera testnet wallet, associate SAUCE and swap.

steps.label: Then
steps.text: Fund the printed guard address with testnet HBAR and set NEXT_PUBLIC_TREASURY_GUARD_ADDRESS in packages/nextjs/.env.local.
